description: Canonical capability vocabulary for the tunnelmind:agent_tools:v1 profile. An AIT's `capabilities` array MUST draw only from these tokens. The witness rejects an AIT declaring a capability outside this set.

capabilities.agent_tools:call_tools: Call tools (functions, MCP tools, APIs) and record each call's outcome, with inputs and outputs as sha256 only.
capabilities.agent_tools:call_models: Call models and record each call's token counts and duration, with the output as sha256 only.
capabilities.agent_tools:handoff: Hand work from one agent to another.
capabilities.agent_tools:ask_human: Ask a human, recorded by role only, to approve, reject or edit something.
